item.title: MDown 1.2
item.description:
Review what your AI tool changed. When an AI tool or another app changes the open file, a Page | Changes switcher appears in the toolbar. Each change is marked where it happened. Accept or reject them one at a time, a block at a time, or all at once.

Export as PDF, and print. File > Export as PDF… saves the page as a PDF that looks the way it does in MDown, with links you can click. Print… (⌘P) prints the same pages.

item.title: MDown 1.1.5
item.description:
Big folders stay fast. The Folder section now lists files in the background and shows 50 at a time, so a folder with thousands of notes never slows MDown down.

The Folder section starts closed each time you open MDown. Open it once and it stays open while you browse.

item.title: MDown 1.1.4
item.description:
The sidebar now shows the folder you're reading in. Click a Markdown file to read it in the same window. The file you were reading stays in Open until you close it. Use the arrow to go up a folder, or Command-click to open a file in a new window.

Choose which sidebar sections appear in Settings.

item.title: MDown 1.1.3
item.description: MDown now opens on the Paper page, the warm, book-like look. Prefer a white page? Choose Plain in Settings. If you already picked a look, it stays.

item.title: MDown 1.1.2
item.description:
• Fixed the active heading in the sidebar when reading or jumping to the final section of a document.
  • Added a small help dot with instructions for making MDown the default Markdown app. It disappears permanently after the instructions are dismissed.

item.title: MDown 1.1.1
item.description: • Opening a block for editing no longer makes the page jump.

item.title: MDown 1.1
item.description:
• MDown now updates itself. It checks once a day, and you can check any time from MDown > Check for Updates… or with the button beside New Document in the sidebar.
  • When a new version is ready, that button turns into an orange arrow. Click it to see what's new and install.

channel.description: Updates for MDown, the simplest and cleanest Markdown editor.
